hardware_target: one NVIDIA CUDA GPU with 8 GiB VRAM, Linux or GPU-enabled WSL2
measurement_notes: This is an unexecuted launch candidate, not evidence that the configuration fits or performs well.
Run one GPU engine at a time; the memory budget is not a shared-GPU reservation.
Freeze exact package lock, CUDA/driver versions, model/tokenizer revision, hardware and launch arguments in each measured run.
Use the same raw prompt bytes, max_tokens, temperature and workload for SGLang comparison.
Eager mode reduces startup/graph memory complexity and is a baseline, not the optimized candidate.
Never use mutable latest container tags as recorded image identity; resolve a digest before deployment.
